title: Geometry: Angles & Shapes
description: Class 5 IMO — Geometry: measuring angles, types of angles, triangles and quadrilaterals, parts of a circle, and 3D shapes with Euler's formula F + V − E = 2.

topics.title: Measuring & Types of Angles
topics.concept:
Angles are measured in degrees (°) with a protractor. An acute angle is less than 90°, a right angle is 90°, and an obtuse angle is between 90° and 180°.

A straight angle is exactly 180°, a reflex angle is between 180° and 360°, and a complete angle is 360°.

examples.solution: It is more than 180° but less than 360°, so it is a reflex angle.

quiz.q: An angle of exactly 90° is a ___ angle.

topics.title: Triangles & Quadrilaterals
topics.concept:
Triangles are named by their sides: an equilateral triangle has 3 equal sides, an isosceles triangle has 2 equal sides, and a scalene triangle has no equal sides.

Quadrilaterals have 4 sides: a square (4 equal sides, 4 right angles), a rectangle, a rhombus (4 equal sides) and a parallelogram (opposite sides equal and parallel).

examples.problem: What is a triangle with all sides equal called?
How many equal sides does a rhombus have?

recap: Equilateral: 3 equal sides; isosceles: 2 equal; scalene: none equal.
Square, rectangle, rhombus and parallelogram are quadrilaterals.

quiz.q: A triangle with exactly 2 equal sides is ___ ?
quiz.explanation: Two equal sides make an isosceles triangle.

quiz.q: How many equal sides does a square have?

topics.title: Circles & 3D Shapes (Euler's Formula)
topics.concept:
For a circle, the distance around it is the circumference, a part of the curve is an arc, and a slice (like a pizza piece) is a sector.

For solid shapes, Euler's formula says Faces + Vertices − Edges = 2. A cube has 6 faces, 8 vertices and 12 edges: 6 + 8 − 12 = 2.

examples.problem: Check Euler's formula for a cube.
What is the distance around a circle called?

recap: Circle: circumference (around), arc (part of curve), sector (slice).

quiz.q: Euler's formula is F + V − E = ___ ?
quiz.explanation: For a solid, Faces + Vertices − Edges = 2.

quiz.q: How many vertices does a cuboid have?

questions.q: Which is the odd one out (three are types of triangle)?
questions.explanation: A rhombus is a quadrilateral; the others are triangles.

questions.q: A straight angle is to 180° as a complete angle is to ___ ?
An angle of 250° is a ___ angle.
questions.explanation: Between 180° and 360° is a reflex angle.

questions.q: A triangle has 3 sides; a quadrilateral has ___ ?
A triangle with all 3 sides equal is ___ ?
questions.explanation: Three equal sides make an equilateral triangle.

questions.q: A triangle with exactly 2 equal sides is ___ ?
questions.explanation: Two equal sides make an isosceles triangle.

questions.q: Euler's formula is F + V − E = ___ ?
For a cube, F + V − E equals ___ ?
The distance all the way around a circle is the ___ ?
questions.explanation: The distance around a circle is its circumference.

questions.q: At 6 o'clock, the two hands of a clock make a ___ angle.
questions.explanation: At 6:00 the hands point opposite ways, making a straight angle (180°).

questions.q: A slice of pizza is shaped most like a ___ of a circle.
questions.explanation: A pizza slice is a sector.

questions.q: A solid has 5 faces and 6 vertices. How many edges does it have (use Euler's formula)?
questions.explanation: F + V − E = 2, so 5 + 6 − E = 2, giving E = 9.

questions.q: A triangle has angles 60°, 60° and 60°. What type of triangle is it?
questions.explanation: Equal angles mean equal sides, so it is equilateral.
